spec: §15 suite F (linking); §9.3: unequal closure hashes under one name, or conflicting devices/layout/data entries, are a link error; equal-closure-hash duplicates deduplicate
derivation: Two defined ext_inc symbols with equal signatures but bodies x+1 and x+2 have unequal closure hashes, so linking their objects is an error (§9.3). Equal-closure duplicates deduplicate. A bare unresolved unpinned import plus a single matching definition instead resolves successfully and is not itself a conflict.
